summary: Shrinks the main PLATE agent-facing instruction surfaces and reorients them around quick routing to authoritative artifacts and live discovery commands.
migration_impact: Downstream PLATE repositories that copy these instruction surfaces will get shorter, routing-oriented prompts. Agents should consult AGENTS.md, SPEC.md, .agentic/releases/, and gh plate release status via the quick-routing table instead of relying on large duplicated prose blocks.
agent_notes: Prefer the quick-routing table for first-step discovery. Treat AGENTS.md as the full process contract, SPEC.md as intent, .agentic/releases/ as implemented evidence, and gh plate release status as the default release-targeting lookup before opening PRs.
migration_guidance: 1. Update .github/copilot-instructions.md and any equivalent template-owned instruction surface from the release that contains this fragment.
2. Keep local prompt surfaces thin: surface-specific behavior plus routing cues only.
3. If you maintain custom agents, point them to authoritative artifacts and live discovery commands instead of copying large process summaries.
